title: Latest handoff projection in fleet lists

effect.user: Fleet lists keep the latest handoff while avoiding hydration of superseded history.
assertions: Complete outputs match latestHandoffOf, including tied timestamps and lifecycle filters.
Fresh mutation, rollback, reopen and audit replay remain correct.
exclusions: Latency, CPU, RSS and whole-daemon cost; move history is unchanged.

repeated.why: Three repetitions of each query shape.

scale.why: 1, 8 and 64 bees, each with 0, 1, 8 or 64 retained handoffs.

background.why: No renderer or runtime is launched.

release.why: Fixture stores close; memory is not measured.

recovery.why: Separate test reopens persisted rows and verifies current views.

fixture.seed: CoreStore admissions and failures with deterministic IDs and tied clocks

recipe.readiness: Isolated SQLite fixture seeded through CoreStore.
recipe.completion: Fresh list call and full output comparison.
recipe.teardown: Close stores and trash temporary fixture directories.

metrics.scope: Rows returned by handoff SELECT beyond the selected latest rows in one fleet-list call
metrics.collector: Per-instance stmt all wrapper around the real CoreStore query
metrics.invariant: Complete outputs equal the point-read reference; no excess handoff rows.

budget.source: Agent gate predeclared 2026-10-03 in Speedy daily plan; deterministic excess-row bound

gaps: Synthetic history distribution; current production frequency unmeasured.
SQL VM work, latency, CPU, heap and RSS are not measured.
Old malformed handoff JSON outside the selected latest rows will no longer be decoded by this read; full-history APIs are unchanged.
readiness: 144 full output comparisons across three repetitions of 48 deterministic cases; zero excess handoff rows; no CPU or latency claim.
